newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer sees clear full-year 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Amer sees clear full-year 1996 loss.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its full-year 1996 result before extraordinary items and tax "will remain clearly lossmaking."
In 1995, Amer posted a 142 million markka pre-tax profit. It had earlier said the full-year 1996 result would show a loss.
"Amer's unprofitable performance has continued during the current interim period," the lastest statement said.

Problems at its Wilson and MacGregor golf operations "continue to have a negative impact on the group's results, as did the implementation of (ski maker) Atomic's new cellular manufacture concept in the first interim period", it said.
Also the absence of its Toyota car-dealing operations, sold last November, would "have an impact on the current interim result", Amer said, but did not elaborate.
"The acquisition of the Time/system distributor in Germany at the beginning of 1996 has postponed sales of Time/system products to the last interim," it said.
Amer's January-August interim results are due for release October 10.
